Make AI decide the smallest operable release from repository evidence and user intent, ask only when a high-risk or irreversible decision cannot be safely inferred, present one approval brief, and preserve deterministic Shipping Harness governance.

Let a non-developer install one local plugin bundle, ask an agent to finish a project, approve one concise brief, monitor truthful progress and blockers, pause safely, repair setup, and receive a closed release without project-specific CLI knowledge.

receipt.goal: Delegate bounded personal/company-internal execution to the verified private OMO runtime while Shipping retains exclusive authority over scope, approval, budgets, human stop, evidence, blockers, SHIPPABLE, and CLOSED.
